tool_args.rationale: The base-field, sink-gradient, and transient-lag signatures jointly favor the siphon-memory ODE. The trajectory batch adds time-resolved data to separate memory dynamics from the sink-modulated drive before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations for five parameters leave no residual degrees of freedom and weakly separate the memory timescale from the coupling strength.
It accounts for sink inhibition but omits the observed coupled transient lag.
